authority: Untouched native be_unit_contrastive bank from complete Wiki24, underlying both BE refit arms
primary_repairs: native pooled wrong to fitted pooled correct
primary_harms: native pooled correct to fitted pooled wrong
coverage_repairs: native no correct member to fitted at least one correct member

new_competitors: All-population fitted all-wrong/common-rival counts, with actual transitions retained
